New house, had some worries about the irrigation overflowing so my first project was to build a hugel mound between the ditch and the house. I have a large patch of coppiced tree of heaven in the front, and used all the limbs to make a wattle fence for the berm.

From the left side of the pic, closest to the water, are three varieties of strawberries(early glow, all star, malwina), early to late harvest placed so the early harvest gets lots of sun before the trees get a lot of leaves, and the late harvest getting lots of sun once the trees fill out. Lots of chervil, caraway, cumin, marigold, and carrots are mixed in with the strawberries. On the top of the berm are the bush berries. From closest to the camera to furthest are three varieties of gooseberries(invictus, hinnomaki, tixia), three varieties of currants(rovada, champagne, jonkheer), jostaberries, followed by three varieties of raspberries(heritage, Anne). Carrots, lupines, and radishes are growing in the gaps to keep the weeds down. Also a couple of spots of rapeseed that I haven't pulled out. I cast out a bucket full of rapeseed when I moved in last August, because it has a huge tap root that helped bust up the clay soil. To the right of that is a long line of carrots, borage, lupine, garlic, and shallot.
